Birch's net balance of 65068 matches my check: orders 101 and 104 total 65068 with no refunds. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance next.

Cobalt's net of 2634 matches my check: orders 102 and 105 total 38498, minus refunds 2289 and 33575 (35864), gives 2634. All three balances match, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme at 33983.
Acme's payout of 33983 is recorded. Next is birch, whose net balance of 65068 I already verified against its orders, so I'll record that payout.
Birch's payout is recorded. Cobalt is the last customer, and its net balance of 2634 matches my check against orders 102 and 105 and their refunds, so I'll record that payout.
All three payouts are recorded. Each net balance matched my independent check against the orders and refunds, so the batch is complete.
